title: E-FRC-0093: the committed rule keeps only the charge U(1) and the overall phase of the three-valued tone, 2 of the 9...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0093 in the gauge arena: the committed rule keeps only the charge U(1) and the overall phase of the three-valued tone, 2 of the 9 generators of U(3), under every way a line can carry a triplet, and no tone relabelling of the SU(3) Weyl group, so it carries no SU(3) color on the tone.
known_limitations: Depth L3 (L3: one base rule produced the result as a measured consequence, with a computed control that could have failed).
